title: Polyxd capability registry
description: What the product can do. Generated UIs may only trigger registered capabilities; risk levels drive required patterns. Owned by PM + engineering.

risk.description: destructive: only from a Confirm. consequential: from a Confirm, a review-and-submit surface, or the finish of Steps whose last step is a review

inputs.description: JSON Schema of the event context this capability accepts

undo.description: Capability that reverses this one. Reversible, low-risk actions run straight away and offer Undo instead of a confirmation

flag.description: OpenFeature flag key; when the flag is off the capability cannot appear

agentMayInvoke.description: Whether an AI agent may trigger it without a human confirming
